title: factory_core is the generic, founder-owned software-factory core
content: factory_core is Jeremy McEntire's own proprietary IP (LICENSE = proprietary; PROVENANCE.md asserts separate, independent shippability). It is generic by construction: it imports nothing target-specific. Every per-target input (repo coordinates, working-agreement docs, compliance rules, role bindings, IdP config) is DATA loaded at runtime through the adapter seams in factory_core/adapters.py, never a code dependency. The dependency arrow points consumer -> factory, never the reverse.

title: No target code in factory_core (enforced by check_core_purity)
content: factory_core/ must import only stdlib + the package itself + an allowlisted third-party set (currently jsonschema); it must contain no un-baselined target-specific token in identifiers/strings; and pyproject.toml must list no target pack as a dependency. scripts/check_core_purity.py enforces all three, fail-closed, wired into make ship. Deleting every target pack must leave the core importable, testable, and green (the portability proof in tests/test_portability.py). Trigger: any change under factory_core/. Action: block on any purity finding.

title: The evidence ledger: content-addressed, hash-chained, SoD-enforcing (factory_core/manifest.py)
content: factory_core/manifest.py is a stdlib-only, append-only ledger of lifecycle transitions. Each entry is content-addressed (SHA-256 of its canonical body) and chained to the prior entry's address (prev_hash), so tampering with any entry breaks the chain at the next link. Every append is fail-closed on segregation of duties: implementer, verifier, and approver must be three distinct identities; any two-role overlap is refused (SegregationError). An optional SegregationPolicy adds alias-canonicalization and approver-is-human resolution. Generalized from the origin target's proven single-manifest ledger pattern (a transferability review flagged that file as stdlib-only, domain-agnostic, copy-as-is); this version adds the append-only hash-chain and strips all domain specifics.

title: Factory macOS isolation grants the trusted Python runtime read-only (2026-08-01)
content: GitHub's macos-14 isolation job failed before its denial probes because actions/setup-python installed CPython under /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework while the Seatbelt profile only named Homebrew and /usr/local runtime layouts. factory_runtime/isolation.py now derives and freezes read-only grants from sys.prefix, sys.base_prefix, and the resolved sys.executable parent before any lane starts, rejects a filesystem-root grant, and leaves lane write and network permissions unchanged. Those paths are explicitly part of the host trusted computing base, not lane-controlled input. Verification covered make ship, native Seatbelt denial and cross-lane proofs, a populated virtualenv pyvenv.cfg case, and real Tessera integration. Kindex node: 9a69c0751603.

title: Factory snapshots publish portably on hosted macOS (2026-08-14)
content: GitHub Actions run 31852306763 exposed a hosted-macOS-only failure: Python 3.12 received PermissionError when snapshot.py removed the staging directory's write bit before os.rename, although local macOS Python 3.14 permitted it. freeze_blob and freeze_tree now keep only the hidden staging root owner-writable through the atomic rename, with payload files and nested directories already read-only; they immediately seal the final content-addressed root and re-derive every byte and mode before returning. A regression shim makes os.rename reject sealed source directories, reproducing the hosted constraint locally for both blob and tree publication. Global Kindex node: 00dbec37c6ab.

title: Ordinary Factory task execution
content: harness/factory.sh creates and starts a run_record task with the requested repository, starting HEAD/tree and assigned agents. The current user request governs scope. Validator accepts the task, resident Orchestrator reviews process and evidence, and Coder/Tester work from independent inputs. Genuine platform permissions and credential boundaries remain in force. docs/SOFTWARE-FACTORY.md is the current workflow authority. Historical mechanisms are retained in Git history, not as startup instructions.
